def fetch_all_products_for_query(q):
    all_products = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        resp = apis.amazon.search_products(query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-rating')
        if not resp:
            break
        all_products.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        # Safety: avoid infinite loops if API repeats
        if page_index > 50:
            break
    return all_products

best_rows = []
for item in shopping_items:
    products = fetch_all_products_for_query(item)
    print('\nITEM:', item, 'total_results:', len(products))
    # Determine availability candidates
    candidates = [p for p in products if p.get('inventory_quantity', 0) and p['inventory_quantity'] > 0]
    print('available_now_candidates:', len(candidates))
    if not candidates:
        candidates = products
        print('No available-now candidates found; relaxing to all results:', len(candidates))
    # Select highest rating, tie -> cheapest
    max_rating = max(p['rating'] for p in candidates) if candidates else None
    top_rating = [p for p in candidates if p['rating'] == max_rating]
    min_price = min(p['price'] for p in top_rating)
    cheapest_among_top = [p for p in top_rating if p['price'] == min_price]
    # deterministic tie-break: higher review count, then lower delivery days, then lower product_id
    chosen = sorted(cheapest_among_top, key=lambda p: (-p.get('num_product_reviews',0), p.get('delivery_days',0), p.get('product_id')))[0]
    print('chosen -> product_id:', chosen['product_id'], 'name:', chosen['name'], 'rating:', chosen['rating'], 'price:', chosen['price'], 'inventory:', chosen.get('inventory_quantity'))
    best_rows.append({
        'shopping_item': item,
        'product_id': chosen['product_id'],
        'product_name': chosen['name'],
        'rating': chosen['rating'],
        'num_product_reviews': chosen.get('num_product_reviews'),
        'price': chosen['price'],
        'delivery_days': chosen.get('delivery_days'),
        'inventory_quantity': chosen.get('inventory_quantity')
    })
